title: Rescued a cat in MallWorld last night, but she escaped
content: We heard a cat crying and found her in some bushes. She was a big chocolate brown Persian cat, very friendly. I got her into a kennel, but she kept escaping out of it; I’d catch her again, put her back in. She had on a yellow collar with a phone number/name embroidered on it. She got out one more time, and I woke up.
